name: Borrowix v1.1.0
body:
## What's changed in v1.1.0

- feat: add GitHub auto-update checker (ad4a867)
- feat: add admin settings layout and super-admin settings page (2f38b61)
- chore: update cloudinary dep + fix form padding (9cc0687)
- refactor: split admin settings into dedicated pages (e504ee7)
- refactor: remove per-user theme selector from sidebar (adfd092)
- refactor: add tenant logo to all layouts (928fc8e)
- feat: add login page branding (e58cc9b)
- feat: add tenant customization and multi-theme support (96eb911)
- feat: add student scan permission and RBAC controls (b99cbaf)
- (feat): Remove the entire DropdownMenuGroup that contains the Settings DropdownMenuItem (bce44b1)
- chore: update docs and gitignore (00e0657)
- chore: update composer dependencies (95c1de9)
- refactor: update status badge and layouts (50d5859)
- feat: add subscription frontend pages and components (0c6a205)
- feat: add trial expiration scheduler command (eb25c04)
- feat: add super admin subscription management and analytics (f398384)
- feat: add admin PayPal checkout and subscription controllers (3d462e1)
- feat: add subscription enforcement middleware (580ed7b)
- feat: add subscription-related mail notifications (80f0c9e)
- feat: add PayPal and subscription services (415acdf)
- feat: add subscription and payment models (523c52f)
- config: add PayPal and subscription configuration files (e7744e2)
- chore: update subscriptions table schema and add payments table (4c336ad)
- chore: remove promo codes feature entirely (18390c8)
- feat: display app version in all layout sidebars (3c5576f)
- chore: add APP_VERSION to .env.example (99f3115)
- feat: display app version v1.0.0 in sidebar footer (5e6c221)
- fix: remove unused router import in scan.tsx (d29d8b1)
- refactor: update charts and fix component imports (bc9cdcc)
- refactor: update theme UI components for new theme system (91f0242)
- refactor: migrate to Tailwind CSS v4 HSL color system (13004a2)
- refactor: consolidate color theme into appearance hook (1bde8ec)
- refactor: simplify theme toggle to light/dark only (6ecabab)
- test: add ScanControllerTest with model and validation tests (439aca6)
- feat: add EquipmentScanLog model and scan logging to ScanController (2b9abbe)
- fix: remove EquipmentSeeder from DatabaseSeeder call (7989c47)
- feat: add QR code scanning for equipment borrowing (5d87ce5)
- fix: resolve 403 unauthorized errors for permission-based authorization (4cba20e)
